The Method

Think with your hands.

Born at the Exploratorium Tinkering Studio, San Francisco — adapted over ten years for Chinese classrooms, museums, and science centers.

Five flagship spaces designed & operated across China · Beijing · Shenzhen · Wenzhou · Xi’an · 2017–2025

01

Ask

Every project starts with a real question — not a textbook page.

02

Make

Materials in hand, kids build the answer themselves. The teacher guides, never dictates.

03

Iterate

Test, fail, adjust, repeat. Failure is treated as data.

04

Own it

Every child leaves with a working piece — and the story of making it.

The System

One system.
Three formats.

From weekly series to camps to single workshops — every unit ships as a complete material kit, field-tested with real kids.

01

Term Series

Weekly Tinkering classes across the school year. Kids explore wide, then go deep on what pulls them.

02

Holiday Camps

18-session themed camps for summer and winter breaks. One hands-on build after another.

03

Single Units

26 Exploratorium lessons and 20 kit units. 60 minutes each, grades 1–6, materials included.

Mechanics & Motion Circuits & Light Electronics & Art Biomimicry Energy & Magnetism Earth & Space

About

China's leading Tinkering curriculum developer.

I'm Mint (Liu Xiaomin) — an independent educator. A decade of building hands-on science spaces across Beijing, Shenzhen, Wenzhou, Xi'an and more.

Curriculum that institutions license and deliver — without me in the room.

  • → Trained at the Exploratorium Tinkering Studio, San Francisco — one of the first Asian educators in the international cohort
  • → Sole Chinese translator of The Art of Tinkering
  • → Designed and operated 5 Tinkering spaces across China
  • → 30+ curriculum units, field-tested across 14+ partner schools
  • → 15,301+ participants · 5,448 students · 4 cities
